summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Flink text stream tokenization and mapping. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which cover codec generation, Python ProcessPoolExecutor configuration, and JAR installation). Peer candidates (test data injection, file reading, environment initialization) are complementary upstream/testing skills, not overlapping. The candidate has clear support evidence from DataStream API documentation and represents a novel, focused capability for text preprocessing in streaming contexts.
